invariants.rationale: Since the result is produced by collecting stream elements to a list, it is always a non-null list.
Mapping over a list with a one-to-one function produces a result list of the same size, unless the input data is null.
Parallelism argument should be positive for valid parallel stream usage.
Every element in data is processed; this is semantically tautological for mapping, but expresses that data is either null or entirely traversed.
The mapping function must be non-null for the method implementation to succeed.
